ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels versus 25% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field on both lobes; continuous black bands along the trailing edges and distal tips; irregular clusters of yellowish-brown pixels in central-mid quadrants; isolated black focal spots on upper-left and upper-right surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute angle of approximately 40 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the vertical lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel amplitude of valleys is deepest on the outer lateral portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the distal tips toward the median notch; outer leading edges exhibit a convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (approximately 8-10) detected primarily on the upper-right quadrant and isolated spots on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous thin, unaligned dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) crossing the white ventral field, primarily with diagonal orientations in the mid-to-lower sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of high-contrast, textured, off-white pixel formations localized on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread yellowish-brown surface discoloration/staining across large contiguous regions of the central ventral fluke surface.
